scope: Static javap inspection of pinned Minecraft and NeoForge-patched classes, not game execution

observations.inventory_save: main slots 0..35, armor 100..103, offhand 150 as byte; skip empty stacks; ItemStack.save with Player.registryAccess; main/armor/offhand order
observations.player_save: Direct saveWithoutId -> writeCompressed temporary -> Util.safeReplaceFile -> firePlayerSavingEvent. Method catches Exception, logs warning, returns void; return is not persistence acknowledgement.
observations.player_load: load .dat, with .dat_old fallback after failed primary; future coordinator must verify authoritative file and transaction marker before admission.
observations.entity_persistent_data: getPersistentData stored under root NeoForgeData; transaction marker belongs inside that compound.
observations.clone_persistent_scope: ServerPlayer.restoreFrom preserves only getPersistentData()[PlayerPersisted] before EventHooks.onPlayerClone; journal runner checks 15 pinned bytecode instructions. V2 transaction markers belong inside this subtree.
observations.player_list_authority: PlayerList.load uses WorldData.getLoadedPlayerTag for isSingleplayerOwner when nonnull; otherwise delegates to PlayerDataStorage.load. UUID.dat alone cannot confirm integrated-owner persistence.
observations.admission_order: placeNewPlayer calls load before adding the player to its players list and before firePlayerLoggedIn; a logged-in event is too late to prevent native load fallback.
observations.removal_order: remove invokes firePlayerLoggedOut, save, then removePlayerImmediately; ordinary disconnect is not a no-save quarantine.
observations.player_data_version: Player.addAdditionalSaveData invokes NbtUtils.addCurrentDataVersion before Inventory.save. Checking Entity/PlayerDataStorage alone misses this call.
observations.world_player_save: MinecraftServer.saveAllChunks supplies PlayerList.getSingleplayerData to LevelStorageAccess.saveDataTag; PrimaryLevelData stores Player inside the Data compound. Actual native saving is not executed.
observations.integrated_player_cache: Pinned client IntegratedPlayerList.save captures owner saveWithoutId into playerData before calling PlayerList.save. getSingleplayerData returns that cache; parent saveAll dispatches virtually to save.
observations.integrated_save_order: MinecraftServer.saveEverything calls playerList.saveAll then saveAllChunks. IntegratedServer delegates to the base method then warns on low disk space; a late exception is not proof that world publication failed.
observations.server_pre_tick_order: Pinned MinecraftServer.tickServer fires fireServerTickPre before tickChildren. Guards cover both entries so a quarantined submission created in Pre cannot continue through the normal child tick entry.
observations.startup_player_list_order: Pinned DedicatedServer.initServer calls setPlayerList before loadLevel. IntegratedServer sets PlayerList in its constructor before initServer calls loadLevel. No native startup executes in this audit.
observations.admission_datafix_event_order: Transformed PlayerDataStorage.lambda$load$1 retains updateToCurrentVersion before the guarded Entity.load call and firePlayerLoadingEvent afterward; source receipt finalization rechecks live player persistent marker in the compiled adapter.

limitations: Static inspection does not validate actual Player, event hooks, transformed mod behavior, crash atomicity or power-loss persistence.
Proposal test uses Inventory(null), actual ItemStack codecs and fixture slot encoding; Inventory.save itself is not called.
Native PlayerDataStorage save differs from asynchronous SavedData.save; do not transfer that API assumption.

Selected startup/save/load/lifecycle call sites are registered and separately transformed against pinned client and dedicated-server bytecode. Source receipts and fresh-process recovery/admission are fixtures. Native game lifecycle, arbitrary-mod compatibility, legacy-marker promotion, unknown cache/mirror repair and complete safe fault shutdown remain unproven or incomplete.
